title: Baladeva Tattva
subtitle: Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha
description: Baladeva Tattva — a themed treasury of teachings gathered by the Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha.

articles.title: Without the Grace of Baladeva We Cannot Get Krishna
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Narrating about the Sri Baladev Tatva, Srila Gurudev, emphasizes on the explanation of our Guruvargas on the various pastimes of Lord Baladev. He elaborates on how we can get the grace of Baladev, Gurudev and Guruvarga without which we cannot get Krishna.

blocks.text: Yesterday we observed the holy advent of Baladeva Prabhu. Baladeva Prabhu is sandhini-shakti-matta-vigraha (the Deity of the sandhinī potency). In his explanation of Sri Govinda-tattva, Srila Bhakti Siddhanta Sarasvata Goswami Prabhupada identifies Sri Baladeva as the Vaibhava-rupa (pastime form) of Lord Govinda. ‘Gāḥ vindati iti govindaḥ’ — the word ‘go’ has several meanings including knowledge, senses, earth, cow and others. Sri Govinda manifests in five forms.

Supreme Lord is Govinda-swarupa, Swayam-rupa. Swarupa is Krishna in Vrindavan, the sweet form.
Para-swarup is Narayan in Vaikuntha.
Vaibhava-swarup—pastime form, with all opulences and power. Baladeva Prabhu is sandhini-shakti-matta-vigraha. He is the Vaibhava-prakash of Govinda. By Him all the things are maintained and all the things have enhanced. He is the absolute function-holder of the personal Godhead Supreme Lord, Sri Krishna.
The antayami (the Indwelling Supersoul), they are three Purush-avatars.
The fifth is Archa-rupa: the Deity form.

This you have to think very deeply. If you do not give much importance to it then you will not get actual benefit. They are not different from Baladeva. Supreme Lord is one, but pastimes are different, in reality, ontologically, they all are the same. In the Vaikuntha (Paravyoma or spiritual sky), Maha-Sankarshan is the Swarupa-amsha—Balaram’s own amsha-avatara. From Him the first manifestation comes in this world for creation, is Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu.
It is written in the shloka by Rupa Goswami,

Vishnu has three forms called Purushas. The first, Karanodakasayi, is the creator of the total material energy (mahat), the second is Garbhodakasayi, who is situated within each universe, and the third is Kshirodakasayi, who lives in the heart of every living being. He who knows these three becomes liberated from the clutches of Maya.

If you have no knowledge of it then you cannot get emancipation. We cannot get ultimate goal. Everything will be failure. He is the only master and enjoyer. We are not masters and enjoyers. When we become averse, illusory energy envelops us and we think we are also masters and enjoyers; we are also Purush. But Purush is only one, Supreme Lord. He is the only Enjoyer and others are to be enjoyed by Him. First, in the causal ocean there is Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu, he thought, “ekoham bahusyam—I am one, I shall become many.” Sah-ikshnah — He glanced on the inert matter, the mahatattva, and transfused conscious energy in it and infinite Brahmandas and infinite planets emanated. As He is infinite, His everything is infinite, infinite planets, infinite Brahmandas, infinite Vaikunthas, infinite living beings and infinite everything. We cannot comprehend. We are the minutest part of the marginal potency of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. How can you comprehend? We have got this body for hundred years only and then it will vanish. We are here in this world only for one hundred years and still we have got vanity. Being of finite intellect, finite sense organs, everything is finite, how can you know the infinite? So after creating infinite Brahmandas, the Lord manifested His second Purush-avatar namely Garbhodakasayi Vishnu to whom Brahma submitted his prayer. Brahma appeared before Garbhodakasayi Vishnu. He is the indwelling monitor of the infinite Brahmandas. And the third manifestation is Kshirodakasayi Vishnu. He is indwel monitor of one Brahmanda and indwelling monitor of every living being. He is inside you. Here in this world, everyone want to be the enjoyer and master, we think, “I am the enjoyer and others are to be enjoyed.” Those infinite living beings appearing from tatastha-shakti, majority of them have their contact with Supreme Lord. They have gone to transcendental realm. They are nitya-mukta — eternally emancipated souls. And others, they set their face against Supreme Lord and see this dazzling world. This world is a shadow of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna, it seems to be blissful, seems to be eternally existing, and seems that there is knowledge in it. Thinking so, the jivas desire to enter into it and jump into it to enjoy. The number of such souls is less, yet they are infinite. There are infinite Brahmandas. We cannot comprehend it. So long as, “I am the enjoyer and master” this sort of ego is there no devotion can be done. “I am of Krishna; I am of Vishnu; He is the enjoyer; I am to be enjoyed”, who have this realization they only are eligible for emancipation—tāni gyātvā vimucyate”. We are the part of the potency. My potency remains for me. Potency of Supreme Lord remains for Supreme Lord. We are not the enjoyers.

Baladeva has got affection for all living beings because they are directly coming from Him. By taking five forms—Sankarshan, Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu, Garbhodakasayi Mahavishnu, Kshirodakasayi Mahavishnu and Sesha, He is doing everything. Bhagavan—‘Bhaga’ means opulences and ‘Van’ means one who possesses them. Baladeva is Bhagavan. You have to give ‘Tulasi’ at the lotus feet of Baladeva and Lotus feet of Nityananda and Gauranga but not at the feet of Guru. Guru appears from the internal potency of Supreme Lord. Krishna takes the form of Balaram and serves Krishna and teaches others how to serve. Without the grace of Baladeva we cannot get Krishna. Without the grace of Nityananda you cannot get Krishna. In Mundaka-sruti it is written, nayam atma bala-hinena labhyah, here this 'bala' is not physical strength, it represents that without the grace of Baladeva you cannot get anything. So you have to pray for His grace and for the grace of all Guruvarga. We should not forget.

Devotees have said that I have got some sort of difficulty so doctors have prohibited me to take part in Kirtans. But I was hearing from here, I could not hear about Baladeva. I could not hear about the preceptorial channel (Jay Dau, Jay Dau). Our Gurudeva used to do this, why? There is reason for it. Gurudev used to sing “Jay Dau! Jay Dau!” This is necessary on the advent day at least and you should sing for Gaur Nityananda, Rohini Devi and the devotees of Gokul Mahavan including Mathura and Baladeva Prabhu, Rohini-nandan Baladeva, in this way. If you do not do it, it will be incomplete. I could not hear this so I said Oh, our Gurudeva used to do this. What is this? I should do this but I cannot do this as I have been prohibited by Doctor because of heart difficulty. You should be very careful in this matter. Bhagavan appears in the sanctified heart— sattvam visuddham vasudeva-sabditam, there is presence of sattva-guna here in this world also which is mixed with rajo-guna and tamo-guna. Vishuddha-sattva means nirguna. It is not mixed with rajo or tamo-guna. The totally sanctified heart is called Vasudeva — sattvam vishudham vasudeva-sabditam. Supreme Lord cannot be enveloped by illusory energy. Supreme Lord is infinite. If you say Supreme Lord can be enveloped by illusory energy then Supreme Lord will be subservient to illusory energy. It is absurd. Clouds can cover our eyes but not the Sun. Sun is million and million times bigger than earth. How a portion of a cloud can obstruct the Sun? They can obstruct our eyes. Heart should be pure. If there no other desire then it is called Vasudeva and the self-effulgent truth appears there. So, make your mind pure.

He performed many pastimes. One pastime is in Bhandir-van. Van is forest. There are twelve forests (Dwadash-van). In Bhandir-van, in summer season it is pleasing, very good and comfortable. It is the time when Krishna and His sakhas, the cowherd boys (confidantes or bosom companions) gather there and Krishna-Balaram give satisfaction to them. They play there making two parties. Everything is in present tense here, Supreme Lord is always present, there is no future and past, therefore the present tense figure is used. One party leader is Baladeva and another party leader is Krishna. And the condition of the play is, if one of the parties is defeated by another, then the defeated will take the victorious on their shoulder and carry. When they started playing, Krishna was defeated by Sridama, Krishna has to carry Sridam on the shoulder. Sridam’s feet will touch the transcendental body of Krishna. In Vrindavan, there is no majesty aspect. Krishna is happy by getting him on the shoulder and Bhadrasen carried Vrishabh. One demon came there in the disguise, in the form of a cowherd. The cowherd boys could not understand where from this cowherd boy came but Krishna understood that he is a demon, Pralambasur. Krishna said you come and play with us. As Krishna’s team got defeated, as per the condition, Pralambasur had to carry Baladeva on his shoulder. He took Baladeva on his shoulder and ran away. Then Baladeva thought this cowherd boy, confidante cannot be sakha. He must be someone else. Krishna has already understood and later Baladeva also understood that he is a demon. Then Baladeva increased His weight so much that the demon could not carry Him. Then demon appeared in his original form with horrible appearance. By seeing that Baladeva said, “I have come here to subdue the evils, and I will do My duty.” He made a big blow on the head and hit the demon, he did blood vomiting and died. All the demigods showered flowers. Our Bhaktivinod Thakur says, “Who is Pralambasur? Pralambasur is within us. Pralambasur represents desire for sex, desire for money, name and fame. You want to take the position of Supreme Lord. You think, “I am the enjoyer and master.” That should be removed from the heart totally, not a scent of it should remain.

You have to take initiative, He is at the back. He will not do everything. It is your duty. You have forgotten Krishna and you have got bad practices. You have to try to remove those practices, Baladeva is there at the back, all our Guruvarga are at the back. When we sincerely try, God will come to help. God helps those who help themselves; there is one pity saying of Herbert. This is one pastime. Again this instance has been discussed yesterday. But you have not heard. This is important. This is one pastime. There is another pastime also. Baladeva is witty with Krishna. Here in Krishna lila, Baladeva is elder brother, Krishna is younger brother. In Rama-lila, Ram is elder brother and Lakshman who is one with Balaram, is younger. Lakshman has been very much mentally worried because He could not serve Rama as per his desire, because He shall have to carry out the order of elder brother. What can be done? He wanted to become an elder brother. So in Krishna-lila, Lakshman has become elder brother, Baladeva. One day, while moving in the forest, Krishna, elder brother Baladeva and other cowherd boys (sakhas) came to Talavan. Tala means palm tree, plump of palm trees there. But there used to reside one demon, a very powerful demon in the form of an ass, donkey. He has got his own party, party of demons. They were guarding it. Nobody can enter into it and do anything. When the sakhas, confidantes entered in to that forest they got the scent the ripened fruits of palm tree, and they are eager to take the taste of it and eat it, they said, “Oh Kanaiah, Dauji bhai! We want to taste this. Give us the fruit of Palmina tree. They are very nice fruit.” When Krishna went, Baladeva said, “No, You are young boy, remain outside. I shall go and pick it, You should not enter.”

He has got affection and also Yashoda Mata and Nanda Maharaj instructed Him, “Please take care of Your younger brother.” They did not see Krishna as Supreme Lord, they are seeing Him as their son, little son, so much affection they have! Baladeva entered into it pushed the trees so forcibly that one tree fell down on another tree, another tree to another tree and all thus all the trees fell down with all the fruits and everything. By that, the horrible demon in the form of ass, donkey, brayed and very harsh sound came. Braying with very harsh sound, he moved towards Baladeva, his power is in his legs, he came to Baladeva and kicked, pressed Him forcibly. Other demons are also there in the forest land. Then again returning back, he wanted to kick Baladeva, but Baladeva took hold of his two legs with two hands and moved him in the air like a circle, very swiftly. Because of this the demon died. Baladeva is powerful. We could not here about Him yesterday. Baladeva appeared from Rohini, He is Rohininandan, the saptam-garbha (the seventh womb) of Devaki, Sankarshan. When He appeared in the womb of Devaki, Yoga-maya attracted this seventh womb of Devaki to Rohini, in Gokul-Mahavan. So Baladeva’s mother is Rohini. He is known as Rohininandan, Balashraya, Balabadhra and Sankarshan as He was attracted by Yoga-maya. Balabhadra means very powerful. He is also Loka Ramanat Ram—one who pleases people (of Gokul). Balaram threw the trees towards other trees and all trees one after the other, fell down and that Gardhab we say, that donkey, collapsed and all his other members also. Now, you will not find any palm tree in Talavan. They have sown something else now. Everything is finished. What are the teachings do we get from this pastime? Gardhab means stupid, ass, donkey, in England, stupid person is called the ass, donkey. So when we try to carry the burden of material learning that is called stupidity. Bhaktivinod Thakur writes in one of his kirtan,

All sorts of material knowledge are variegated forms of illusory energy which creates impediments on the path of Your worship. Such knowledge creates attachment for this perishable worldly relations and makes an ass out of the living entity.

We want to earn this material learning. What is it said here? All the material learning and material knowledge is the vaibhav, grandeur, it is the outside appearance of grandeur of education, of knowledge, of learning but actually, it is not. It is all, mayara vaibhav, tomara bhajane badha — when we shall have this grandeur, material learning, it becomes hindrance to our Bhajan. And moha janita anitya samshare jiv ke kare gadha — when one will get this sort of knowledge, like a donkey or dunderhead or dunderpate, what is it called? He is carrying so many loin clothes, but cannot wear one cloth. He is also carrying many other good items like sugar but he cannot taste anything, only carrying the burden. Similarly, we are carrying the burden of this material knowledge. By the influence of that knowledge, we have forgotten our own self. We think I am this body, bodily relation is my relation and we are giving all our energy for these non-eternal things. So we should not become dunderpet-dunderhead. We should not become fool No. 1, As Param Pujyapad Swami Maharaj used to say Fool No.1. Those who do not believe in God, they are Fool No.1. One young person came to Swami Maharaj and said “Swamiji, you are preaching devotion to God, I do not believe in God.” Then Swami Maharaj said “Who has given you the power to you to say I do not believe in God? If the power is withdrawn can you speak? How long can you speak? How long you can live in this world? You have got this vanity. When the power will be taken can you speak anything?” So, this sort of vanity, false vanity we also have got. We should have asked, “Who am I? What is the Ultimate? What is my actual relation with the Ultimate and what is the method of worshiping Him?” Method of worshiping Him is given in Bhakti-rasamrita-sindhu. As per the direction of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, Rupa Goswami has written it. Whatever sense organs you have got, (and) mind, God is residing inside you; with the mind, you engage everything for the service of Krishna, Radha-Krishna. By the grace of Radha, you can get Krishna, by the grace of Krishna you can get Radha. Radha-Krishna.

You have to engage all your sense organs, everything. We may think, “Oh, then how can we maintain our family when there is no money?” A true devotee gives his full energy to Supreme Lord, thinking about Him. Supreme Lord is maintaining the whole world. Will he not maintain a devotee? Krishna says in Gita, yogakshema vahamyaham — I will provide whatever is required for My devotee and will preserve whatever he has. You have got no belief. What is this? Do it and see whether He is giving or not. When you depend upon Him, He provides everything. Even I saw in my family, I was depending on my father for whatever I wanted. Other brothers used to ask for their requirements, “I have got no clothes, I have got no garments, I want to be admitted to this college” in this way. I did not say anything. But father immediately asked me, “What is this? You do not required anything?” Father brought some garments for me, automatically things were coming and I did not say I shall go to college for higher studies and so on. He automatically was doing everything. Others are doing by their own initiative. A human being if you take shelter to him, he is forced to think about you. Will the Supreme Lord not think about us? What is the necessity of all this money? The necessity is for the love of Krishna. Only for maintenance you need something, only something (money). As our Param Gurudeva has said in his last message to all the devotees, “You all should worship advaiy-gyan (non-dual personality) Krishna, RadhaKrishna, to satisfy His transcendental sense organs, taking shelter of a Guru, with one pointed devotion, remaining with others amicably.”

When the target will be one, there will be no fight. When target will be different, money, name and fame, something of this world, this thing, that thing, then there will be quarrel. When target is Supreme Lord’s satisfaction, one may be serving more and another may be serving less; if the center is one, there will be no clashing. When the center is one, there will be no clashes. When center is different there will be clash.
Already it is the time so some kirtan should be done.

articles.title: Lord Sri Baldev Removes Our Material Desires
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Srila Gurudeva elaborately explains the esoteric meaning of the killing of Pralambhasura and Dhenukasura. With very strong and powerful words, he emphasizes on removing the desires of illicit sex relations, material gains and name and fame from our heart. He narrates that if we take absolute shelter at the lotus feet of Baladeva, He will regulate and govern our heart and will remove those desires forcibly.

blocks.text: This is the first time we have got the opportunity to come to Boston. We have not come here before. Everything is regulated by Supreme Lord. Whatever He desires it will be fulfilled. You may have innumerable desires but if Supreme Lord does not fulfill those desires you cannot get it. It is the fortune of devotees, especially Sanjaydas Prabhu, to be an instrumental to organize the program here. We have also got benefited by coming here. Whatever is done by Supreme Lord is all good. It is for the eternal benefit of all, not one sided business. You will be benefited, we will also be benefited. Today is very auspicious day (the appearance day of Lord Baladeva); we have never been outside India on this day before. This is the first time. It is Krishna’s desire. I was on tour with different countries of Europe and England. From there, I returned to Puri to participate in Jagannath Deva Rathayatra festival. We have a big Math there at the holy birth site of Srila Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Goswami Thakur, the founder of Chaitanya Math and Gaudiya Math organizations. The original founder is Bhaktivinoda Thakur and by his direction, Srila Param Gurudeva spread this message of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu to all corners of the globe. Our Gurudeva used to go to Vrindavan to observe the advent of Lord Baladeva and to take part in the Jhulan Utsava (the swinging ceremony of Radha-Govinda). We also used to go there almost every year. This time I came to know that we have program to go outside during this time. I do not make any program. It is Lord’s desire. The in-charge of Vrindavan Math insisted me to go there during swinging ceremony, repeated and forcibly. What can I do? Everything is determined by the Supreme Lord. I ask for forgiveness to him. I pray to him if I have committed any offence, he may forgive me.

The pastimes of Baladeva are eternal. All pastimes of Baladeva or Krishna’s numerous descended forms, I should not use the word ‘incarnation’, there are some words for which you do not find appropriate words to express them. As per the dictionary, ‘incarnation’ word is also applicable for human beings, enslaved jivas. I have seen that in their usage. But all the forms of Krishna are transcendental and spiritual. They have Absolute-Existence, Absolute-Knowledge and Absolute-Bliss, the purna-sacidananda-vigrah. They descend here. There are infinite brahmandas and an infinite transcendental realm (Vaikuntha). Everything of Supreme Lord is infinite because He is infinite. There are infinite living beings. We cannot comprehend. If we can comprehend then Supreme Lord will lose His absolute infinite position. Nobody can comprehend Him. As per our degree of submission, as per degree of our taking shelter to the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord, the glories of Him descend to that degree. But that is not the last. Nobody can say, I have fully realized. If someone says like that then it is ignorance. Brahma in his prayer to Krishna has said:

He prays, “If anybody says I have realized or known everything about Krishna, I do not want to say anything to him, I could not understand Krishna. Even I could not recognize His personal associates—the cowherd boys. I committed a great offence by stealing the calves and the cowherd boys. I did that when they were about to eat to examine whether Krishna is Supreme Lord or not. I have committed a great offence. Not to speak of others, even I could not recognize Krishna and His personal associates—the cowherd boys. If anybody says he can know Him, let him know .”

Nobody can know the infinite. If Supreme Lord is known by any kind of efforts then He will lose His infinite position. Realization about Him always remains incomplete. So pure devotees (suddha bhakta) are always humble, they have no vanity as they know that whatever they have realized is nothing. Ananta Deva (The Lord Shesh) is uttering the name of Krishna from infinite time, until now, but He cannot finish relishing the taste. The transcendental sweetness of Krishna’s name is always fresh, it cannot become stale.

As we have heard from our Guruvarga, Baladeva’s pastimes are eternal, in consideration of two senses. There are infinite brahmandas. Now Baladeva has appeared in this brahmanda, this world. After His appearance, He will perform His childhood pastimes and after that He will perform pastimes of Prauganda, which is the time between childhood and adolescence, after Prauganda there will be pastimes of adolescence and so on. Once a pastime will finish here, immediately, that will start in another brahmanda. So, all His pastimes are eternal. In this sense, Baladeva’s advent is eternal.

In another sense, He is appearing in the sanctifying heart of a pure devotee. We do not know whom will He bless. Nobody can do anything without His knowledge. We think ourselves, I am a great devotee. But fruits are regulated by Him. They are not in our hand.

One example I want to narrate which I have heard from Gurudeva and other Guruvarga. I had no opportunity to see Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Thakur. I joined the institution in 1947 just after my academic career. I was of the age 24 that time. So I had no opportunity to see our Paramgurdeva. He had been to our place, Assam. That time I was very young. He set his holy footprints in our place. He used to speak harikatha all the time. His servitor’s name was Sajjananada Maharaj. He was a brahmachari not a sanyasi but everyone used to address him as Maharaj. He was serving Saraswati Thakur with great devoutness and earnestness. So everybody used to give him respect. One person, in a worldly sense, very qualified (double M. A.), took sanyas from our Paramgurdeva. But he did not know the devotional conclusive thoughts. He had the desire to know pure devotional conclusive thoughts. That time there were so many stalwart disciples of Saraswati Thakur who used to deliver speeches on devotion, Bon Goswami Maharaj, Goswami Maharaj, Sridhardeva Goswami Maharaj, Keshava Goswami Maharaj. They are all senior God brothers of our Gurudeva.

The person who took sanyas approached our Paramgurudeva saying, “I have joined the institution but I have got no actual knowledge of pure devotion of Mahaprabhu’s school of thought. You have so many duties to perform. So you are always busy but you have many stalwart disciples. If I approach them they also might say that they are busy and do not have time but if you order one of them then they will spent some time for me to teach me Bhagavat-dharma, pure devotion.”
Then our Paramgurudeva asked him, “Do you seriously want to know the principles of pure devotion conclusions?”
“Yes.”
“Is it true?”
“Yes.”
“Then you go to Ramadas.”

He used to work in the garden and was tending the cows. Outside persons thought he is the servant of the institution. They did not know much about him. But our Paramgurudeva sent the sanyasi to Ramadas. Sitting in his own small room, Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Goswami could understand that this person is a sincere soul and performing bhajan sincerely from the core of the heart without any ulterior desires in the mind. Supreme Lord and His absolute counterpart Gurudeva are omniscient. Nobody should do anything against their desire. They know everything. They may not say. If they start saying then those persons, the new entrants, neophytes, they will be puzzled thinking, “Oh, Gurumaharaj knows all our defects. What to do?” For that reason, even though knowing everything fully well, they do not say anything. They know everything and they can say (They have that capability).

The educated person who had taken sannyas was told by Saraswati Thakur, “Go to that person. He is working in the garden.” Hearing so, he was astounded and thought, “I have never seen Gurudeva speaking intimately with him (Ramadas). So many stalwart figures are there and my most revered Gurudeva did not mention their name. He is serving in a garden. I have never seen him speaking. What will he teach me?” By Gurudeva’s order he was forced to go, compelled to go, otherwise he may commit offence to the lotus feet of Gurudeva. Unwillingly he went there and made obeisance to that person.
Ramadas told, “Why are you paying obeisance? I am an ordinary person. You should not do this.”

“No. I approached you to know Bhagavat Dharma and Bhakti Dharma. I prayed to Gurudeva to direct me to any of his eminent and competent disciples. If he directs then they will give some attention to me. Then he confirmed my sincerity and directed me to come to you. I never have seen you speak before.”

“Then why have you come to me? I am an illiterate person. I cannot give any evidence from the scriptures. You see, I am only serving the cows and serving in the garden. You have committed a mistake. Only a competent person can explain the Bhakti Siddhant.”
So he returned. After some days he again went to Gurudeva and requested, “Kindly please direct me to some prominent sannyasi to teach me.”
“I directed you to go to Ramadas. You did not go there?”
“I did go. He is saying he does not know anything.

Then our Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Goswami Thakur got dissatisfied and told him, “He knows everything. You go there and ask him.” Because Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Thakur knew the mind of the sanyasi. He wanted to deliver a speech in the meeting and get name and fame from conditioned souls of the world. That is not the purpose of shuddha-bhakti. Shuddha-bhakti’s target is to satisfy Krishna. If you want shuddha-bhakti, no other desire or intention should be there.
Ramadas was sincere. Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Goswami engaged him in the service of cows and garden. He advised, “Go there. You hear from him. Then you will know what is shuddha-bhakti.”
Again he went. This is a fact. It is not a story. Then he went there and paid obeisances and told, “Gurudeva will be satisfied. Kindly please tell me what is shuddha-bhakti.”

Then Ramadas said, “I do not know any sanskrit verses but what is this garden? It is not a garden of a worldly person for worldly interest this garden belongs to Guru Gauranga Gandharvika Giridhari. Whatever you are growing, the vegetables and all, it will be offered to Guru Gauranga Gandharvika Giridhari. That Prasad will be accepted by the Vaishnavas. And cows are very dear to Krishna. So I have been asked to do this service as the milk will be offered to Radha Krishna and that Prasad will be given to Gurudeva and Vaishnavas. You see, I cannot say any evidence from scripture.”

This body is from external potency of Supreme Lord. He is the Lord, owner of all kinds of opulence. This body is the outcome of His external potency. Your potency works for you. My potency works for me. The potency of Supreme Lord should work for Supreme Lord. You are a part of the potency. You are the servant of the servants of the servants of Supreme Lord. This body belongs to Supreme Lord. You are not the owner of this body. Where from have you got this body? According to Gita,

You have got this body from the aparā potency, material energy. You have not got hold over your body. You cannot enjoy this. This body is to be dedicated for the service of Supreme Lord. It belongs to Him not you. It is a product of His potency. And your subtle body also came out of aparā (external) potency, according to Gita. He is the owner of aparā potency. He is the owner of all living beings. Gross body and subtle body do not belong to you. In Gita He also says,

The real self is the outcome of the spiritual energy, parā, superior potency of Krishna. As it is His energy, it is to be dominated and enjoyed by Him. You are not the enjoyer or master. Your gross body, subtle body and you yourself, the real self, everything belongs to Krishna. So you have to engage your sense organs, your mind, words everything for the service of Krishna. In this kaliyuga you should utter the name, Mahamantra. Ramadas was doing it always.

He was working in the gardens, growing vegetables etc. and along with that he was always uttering Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare Hare Ram Hare Ram Ram Ram Hare Hare. Very sincerely, he was doing the service of the cows. As cows are very dear to Krishna, for Krishna‘s service he is tending the cows. His target is good. Outside person cannot understand but Krishna understands who is sincere and who is not sincere and He will give the fruit, not these worldly people. He is regulating the fruits,

You can do action but you have no hold over the fruits. Why you are worried whether I shall get proper judgment or not. Why do you worry? Will human beings give you the fruit? Fruits are controlled by Supreme Lord. What is the use of being worried? You try to do your own duty with the target of satisfying Krishna and His personal associates, nothing else. You should not lose the mark. If you lose the mark everything will be spoiled. Target should be correct. We are of Krishna, we are from Krishna. We are by Krishna. We should remain for Krishna. Fruit will be given by Supreme Lord. We should see our own defects. Don’t try to see defects of others. If you always speak about the defects of others then by those evils thought you pollute your mind. What benefit will you get? You see your defects and try to see qualities in others. Someone may be a bad person but he also has some good qualities. Everyone has both—good and bad qualities. As, a swan has the capacity to take out milk from the mixture of milk and water, Vaishnavas are Paramahamsa. 'Hamsa' means swan and Vaishnavas are 'Parama-hamsa', they see good qualities in others. They do not see bad qualities. Only they have got the compassion for conditioned souls of the world. Out of affection, for his eternal welfare, they say, "You should do this, you should not do this." Such compassion is rarely to be found. Only sincere souls can get the contact of such Vaishanavas. Out of affection, Gurudeva governs and regulates the disciples. We have to have the eligibility to be regulated otherwise he also neglects those persons who have got vanity, who have no submission. I have seen this. Our Vaikhanas Maharaj, sanyas Guru of our Gurudeva and Puri Goswami Maharaj and others, was very learned. He was from Orissa. He was speaking in Mayapur in Oriya. Some persons were asking questions and he was answering. But when he saw these persons are not serious in worshipping Krishna, they are now asking questions to substantiate their own mental speculation, they have no desire to accept the truth then he stopped replying. He was only smiling. Whatever they asked he stopped speaking. There should be sincerity. Insincere, hypocrites cannot get eternal welfare. God is a person. He is complete. Nobody can bribe him. You can bribe worldly people, judges (magistrates) and have the judgment accordingly, but the person who is giving bribe, that person is also within Krishna. Nothing is outside Krishna. They are dust particles, how can they give bribe to Krishna? He is the complete being. Nobody can bribe Him and change His judgment. He knows everything. He is omniscient, He is seeing everything. He is regulating the fruits. Why should you think? You should try to do bhajan.

If you can get the grace of Baladeva, all these ulterior motives will be removed. Baladeva appeared as the son of Rohini Devi. And by Krishna’s direction, Yogamaya (internal spiritual energy) attracted the womb of Devaki and kept that womb in another wife of Vasudeva, Rohini Devi in Gokula-mahavan. Baladeva Prabhu is actually not Devaki-nandan, He is Rohini-nandan. He is also known as Sankarshan (Garbha Sankarshanata Sankarshan). The Garbha (womb) was attracted by Yogamaya and pulled from there and put in the womb of Rohini Devi. He is very powerful—Balasyata Balbhadra. He is the presiding deity of existence. He is the preserver of the existence and expansion of the existence—sandhini shakti-mat vigrah. He is very powerful, strongest, there is no equal to Him. All the things of service of Krishna in the spiritual realm, everything is spiritual, nothing is material. There, the flute can speak and can take initiative. The singhasan—the throne, can speak, His clothes can speak. They are not matter, they are spiritual. When spirit is there, only ānanda (bliss) is there. A small boy is loved by his parents for as long as sat-chit-ānand, ātma is there in his body. As soon as consciousness leaves his body, he is dead. You can chemically preserve his body for a long time and then take it to his parents, will the parents be happy? No. They will say take it away. I don’t want see. So the beloved child is not there. The living entity that was giving us happiness is absent. Even consciousness exists in a parrot, in a cat etc., being enveloped by gross and subtle body, yet that existence of blissful thing gives happiness. But when consciousness leaves the body, dead body cannot be a cause of happiness. It is devoid of happiness and it causes suffering when seen. Take it away, burn it or bury it. The real person is gone. A particle of consciousness, as long as it exists, life persists. As soon as the particle of consciousness leaves, a dead body remains which creates fear. The cause of these infinite particles of conscious units is Supreme Lord. You are seeing so many particles of the rays of the Sun. Where from are they coming? They are coming from the Sun. And Sun is sustaining and maintaining them. Like that, you are seeing infinite beings, in your room. You see so many ants, worms, also so many persons. So many trees they have got life. These conscious particles, where from they are coming? Nothing cannot be the cause of something. Devoid of consciousness cannot produce consciousness.

From Krishna all the jīvas are coming, they are maintained by Krishna, they are in Krishna, they are by Krishna, and they will go to Krishna. Krishna is Absolute Substance, Absolute Bliss, Infinite Bliss. Our requirement is Krishna. And Krishna’s personal associates are also spiritual. They are in transcendental spiritual realm, there, nothing is matter. No past and future, only present. Everything is eternal. Ātma cannot be destroyed. All the real selves have the realization of their relation with Supreme Lord. He is the only enjoyer or master. There is no other enjoyer or master. He is the only Purush,

Krishna says, “I am the only master.” And there is no other Purush. Purush is He Himself and others are dominated and enjoyed by Him. We are the parts of His potency. We are not enjoyer or master. In that transcendental realm, there cannot be any quarrel or fight. Why? Center of interest is one. All the servitor’s attention is to satisfy Krishna. There is no other interest. They are serving in different love relations. No other target is there. When the center of interest is one there cannot be any clash. If there are different centers of interest there will be clashing. It is inevitable. If you draw one circle with one center and another with another center then the circumference will cross. But if there is one center, then the circles can be bigger or smaller, there will be no crossing. Some may serve more, some may serve less but their target is the same. There in Vaikuntha Dham, in Goloka Vrindavan there cannot be any clashing. But here in this world, forgetting Krishna, our real relation with Krishna, we have come to this world. We have got this misconception of self and we have become liliput (tiny) Krishna. Everybody wants to enjoy life. Here, females are also posing themselves as Purush, and male is also doing so. Because of their forgetfulness of relation with Supreme Lord Sri Krishna they have become averse to Him so illusory energy has enveloped them and they want to enjoy this world, they have become liliput Krishna. Everybody is trying to enjoy others. So everywhere in the family, in the society, in the country, there is clashing. There are different centers of interest. But there in Goloka Vrindavan there can be no possibility. He is the only master. He is the only Purush. We are not Purush, we are Prakriti.

Krishna has taken the form of Baladeva to give this knowledge, as Guru. He has got affection for all the conditioned souls of the world. Krishna does not govern, regulate or punish, but Baladeva punishes.

Baladeva killed Pralambasura. He also killed Dhenukasura. What does that tell? When Krishna became a bit grown up, Krishna-Gopastami was performed. The childhood is up to five years, from five to fifteen years, it is Paugaund. At the age of ten years, Nanda Maharaj engaged Him in tending the cows. Previously, they were tending the calves. Krishna and all the sakhas, playmates, used to gather at one place and go to Bhandirvan, one forest, for tending the cows.

The sakhas (friends), you find in this world are not real. This world is the perverted reflection of that world. When we do not want to worship Krishna as master and want to enjoy this world, then Krishna sends us to this prison house to get non-eternal master and servants. There will be separation grief. We do not want to serve Krishna as our friend, so He says go there, there are non-eternal friendship relations. More the attachment, there will be more grief in separation. You do not want to worship Krishna as son then go to the non-eternal world to get non-eternal son. When between son and father, there is separation there will be extreme grief. As much attachment we shall have with non-eternal relations so much grief we have to suffer. If you do not worship Him as husband, you go there to get a non-eternal husband, all relations are with Krishna. When we do not want to serve Him then we are sent to this perverted reflection of Vaikuntha. Highest is the gopi-prem. In this world, we think we are this body and for bodily enjoyments, we are being attached by false love which is the most lustful, heinous. But there it is the highest. There the lowest is shanta-rasa. Shanta-rasa is when they become indifferent to Krishna, they are serving with indifference. But here, neutrality is the highest because all the relations are non-eternal and those who are neutral they are called very wise persons, highest persons. But there neutrality is the lowest. So it is perverted reflection. A tree is reflected in the water just the reverse. If you see yourself in the mirror, right will be reflected as left and left will be reflected as right. It is just the reverse. Like that. All relations are with Lord Sri Krishna. Baladeva did this lila (tending cows) with His eternal friends, confidantes, bosom friends there. And with joy and excitement, dancing and singing and playing so many games, they have forgotten everything. Small children forget everything when they play. That time even if their mother calls them to take food, they say, “No, we want to play more.” Children have this sort of habit. And they are so much absorbed in playing and dancing, cows were moving independently. Nobody was watching them. In one game, some of the devotees were on Krishna’s side, Krishna is the leader and others will be on the Baladeva’s side where Baladeva is the leader. The game is that if any party defeats the other party, that defeated devotees should carry the winner devotees on their shoulder. Just when the game started, Krishna was defeated. By whom? Krishna was defeated by Sudam. And Vrishabh was defeated by Bhadrasen, both belonged to Balaram’s party. Balaram’s group won. Krishna had to carry Sudam on His shoulders. This is the evidence of Vraja-prem. There is no majestic aspect. When Sudam ascended on the shoulder of Krishna then his feet was touching Krishna. Is it Bhakti? What is this Bhakti? Krishna is playing with gladness, carrying him on shoulders. This is Vraja-prem, sweetness. Bhadrasen is carrying Vrishabh. And Baladeva is carried by Pralambasura. Pralambasura was a demon but he entered in the game in the form of a gopa to cause nuisance. All the other gopas could not understand. Krishna understood that he is a hypocrite. He thought, “Alright, I shall take you to My side to kill you.” Others could not understand. And he carried Balaram on his shoulders. He carried and he fled from there with Balaram. All got disturbed. He was continuously running and took Balaram very far. Balaram thought that this is some demon. Balaram became so heavy that the demon could not move, and he manifested his huge form. Seeing that Baladeva thought he is not a gopa. He told, “Alright, My appearance is to kill demons.” He punched him in the head. It got split and he started vomiting blood and died. All the demigods were very happy to see killing of the demon in Bhandirvan. Which demon was that? Bhaktivinoda Thakur has explained that demon is within us. That demon means stri-lampatya—desire for illicit sex connection and labh-puja-pratistha asha—desire for money, fame and respect. Understood? Desire for illicit sex connection, it is the greatest obstacle in this path. It is Pralambasura, and he must be killed. If (material) desire is there, there cannot be any Bhakti. We are holding discourses, kirtan, thinking about some money. We should speak harikatha, we will do hari kirtan but one thousand dollars should be given. Target is Dollar. That is not Bhakti. Why are you asking this? Do not you have any belief in Krishna? Think. Very deeply. If I go to anybody’s house here, he may be a good person or a bad person and I remain in his house, doing all service and demanding nothing, take absolute shelter, how long he shall remain silent? He may be a rogue person. Even a rogue person will not be able to bear this. He will think that this person is doing all this services and without feeding him how can I eat? (He may not feed him for a few days but) After a few days he won’t be able to do so. A human being will be unable to do this. (He will think) ‘I am wearing the garment and I shall not give the garment to him, how? I should give him.’ (Such feeling will come) Automatically, a human being cannot remain silent. Supreme Lord is the sustainer of infinite Brahmands, for His service I have to demand something from somebody? Why? What for? If you have got the belief, will He not sustain and maintain? You think about it. Why shall I demand? For professional chanters, professional speakers, they are not actually serving Krishna. Their target is something else. Automatically everything will come. A son of a king, he does not know, he forgets his father, he is moving on the road begging. Someone asked, “Why you are begging? You are the son of the King.” He is taken to the King. When he gets his father, is there any difficulty now? Everything comes automatically now. We are the sons of Supreme Lord; He is the sustainer and maintainer. If you take shelter to Him, everything will come automatically. Krishna says in Gita, yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham — “I fulfill all his needs and preserve whatever he has.” You don't have to ask for anything. Shuddha-bhakta does not take anything. Supreme Lord wants to give. You want ownership? Sankarshan was saying to Vritrasura,
“Do you want the planet Dhruva ?”
“No.”
“Take ownership of Brahmanda?”
“No.”
“Why? Whatever you want I can give. Become the owner of this world?”
“No.”
“What do you want? Ownership of Netherworld?”
“No.”
“Eighteen yogika attainments?”
“No.”
“Salvation?”
“No.”

Samañjasa tvā virahayya kāṅkṣe — "I want only causeless, one pointed devotion unto Your Lotus feet and nothing else. All these are the cause of bondage. These are not for Your satisfaction. I do not want." If he gets Krishna then everything is within Him. So Shuddha-bhaktas are very clever. They do not accept all this. But if I am given all these things, I will not say all these things. There are many rich persons in America. If they say, “Why are you taking so much botheration in this Math? I shall give you 100 million dollars. Make your own Math and remain there in comfort and do bhajan.” We think, “Oh! My coming to Gaudiya Math is successful. I am jumping. I shall go. If someone gives this I shall be dancing.” Shuddha-bhakta do not want this. They always want the service of Supreme Lord. They do not have love for material gain. If that is the target then everything will be lost. Non-eternal gain in this world, profit, non-eternal benefits in this world and higher worlds, within this Brahmanda, it is Labha—material benefits, that is not service to Krishna. Desire for getting worship from others, someone will worship me, they will respect me, Labha-pooja. I demand reverence from others. I demand others should worship me, I am the object of worship, Pratishtha, name and fame, if you are running after these, then you cannot get Krishna. This is Pralambhasura. Who will rescue us from this Pralambhasura? Baladeva. Take shelter to Him. Baladeva will kill this Pralambhasura, but actually we are afraid of taking the grace, “Oh we want to keep them—name and fame.” Whatever you had got, you have renounced, and again you are running after it? What for you are here? You have taken shelter to Gurudeva. If you do not serve Krishna, you will be indebted to your parent and others that you cannot pay back. What for? Parents have brought you up and taught you. If you do not serve Krishna you will be indebted. Then, you shall be hurled down to this world. You would have committed a sin but if you serve Krishna then you can pay back the debts. For that purpose you have come (to Math). You should have remained in the house, what for have you come (to Matha)? That demon is within us. Baladeva killed the outside demon but what about the inside demon? Bhaktivinoda Thakur said, “Desire for illicit sex connection, desire for debauchery”—Lampatya, material gains—Labha as Pralambhasur. Is this the criteria to understand whether the preaching is good or not? So much money should come, so many building should be constructed, so many things for name and fame, that is not the target. Target should be satisfaction of Krishna. When I shall die, everything will remain here. Nothing will go with us. Ambarish Maharaj, outside he was the autocrat of the whole world but he had no attachment. He had the knowledge that whatever I have got in my life, I will be deprived from this. One rich man was there in Howrah, Surekha. And our Sitaramji Mahendru, ultimately, he became the General Manager of Punjab National bank. We got acquainted with him when he was manager in Ludhiyana, Punjab. He had intimate connection with Surekha. He sent me to Surekha. He said, “You go, you will get money from Surekha.” I went to him and he gave some donation to us. Next time when I went, he said he had become a pauper, poor man. He had nothing. He was a millionaire and in his this life he became a pauper. Ambarish Maharaj saw the worldly property like a dream. In a dream you become anything. You become Prime Minister, you become President. When you wake up you realize, you were lying on the bed in a room. But at the time of seeing the dream you think it to be true. Like that we are seeing here. We are laughing, we are crying, and everything is a dream, nothing. And this property is like lump of matter, it has got no value, whole worldly property. Even if you get this sort of enjoying spirit, you will go to hell and you will be enveloped in this nescience.
It is said, in Srimad Bhagavatam,

lines: avyayāṁ ca śriyaṁ labdhvā vibhavaṁ cātulaṁ bhuvi
vidvān vibhava-nirvāṇaṁ tamo viśati yat pumān

blocks.text: It is there in Ambarish Maharaj’s biography. Ambarish Maharaj’s biography is written in Srimad Bhagavatam in 9th canto by Vedavyas Muni.

This Pralambhasura should be killed. Who will rescue us? Balaram. There's one more demon—Dhenukasura. It means Gardabhasura. That demon’s appearance is like that of an ass, have you seen an ass? Donkey? That ass had formidable power. He was a demon who came in the form of an ass. He had a big body. And he got his own team who were also in the form of ass. They thought they were the owners of all these palm trees and its fruits. All the sakhas were with Krishna and Balaram. They got the scent of Palm fruits and said Kanhaiya, “We want to eat these sweet fruits. But that demon did not allow anyone to enter. They are enjoying the whole forest. Nobody should enjoy it. Whoever enters they would kill him.” Krishna said, “It’s ok I will go there.” Then Baladeva said, “No You stay, I will go first.” Yashoda Mata and Nanda Maharaj had said to Balaram, “You are elder brother; You should take care of Krishna. Krishna is young. His intelligence is less. Krishna is small, He has no knowledge, no sense.” Balaram is to look after Him. This is Vraja-prem (love of Vraja-dham). Krishna is Supreme Lord. But they see Him like this. Baladeva went into the forest of Palm trees and shook the trees so hard that so many fruits fell on the ground. On hearing the sound of the fruits falling, Gardhabasura got enraged, “Who has come here? Who is destroying this?” Out of wrath and indignation he kicked on the chest of Balaram. Balaram tolerated that. After doing that, he saw that Balaram was not killed. He thought, “When I kick, everybody is dead. Again I will strike.” When he tried to kick Baladeva again, Baladeva got hold of his two feet and revolved him forcibly and by that, the demon was killed. When he was killed, Baladeva threw him on the trees. When he hit the trees, one tree after the other, all trees fell down. Other kith and kin asses also came. Baladeva threw them and they also got killed. Now, if you go to Talavan, you will not find palm trees, but they have grown something else now. But everything was finished. Dhenukasura was killed. Who is Dhenukasura? What is the significance of Dhenukasura? Ass. Who is an ass? An ass has got no intelligence. Those who use the ass for carrying the load, sometimes the owner of these asses think that I do not want to burden them so much, let me give them less weight. Usually they go ten times but then with less weight they will have to go fifteen times. But if you put less weight on them they will not move. It will only move if full weight is put on them. They do not understand their own interest. Asses are those who have got no knowledge of their own self. Ignorance and previous impressions of the world, they cannot give up. They are ready to take the burden of the whole family but they are not ready to worship Krishna. The whole burden they are carrying like an ass. You should think about it. You are a human being. Who are you? Where have you come from? What relation you have got with Supreme Lord? You should not be so ignorant like an ass. You should enquire about this human birth. So this sort of ignorance of our own self and our relation with Supreme Lord, that ignorance and nescience is the ass. That ass should be killed. How will it be killed? Baladeva, Gurudeva can rescue us. Baladeva has appeared in this world as Nityananda. Nityananda and Baladeva are same. Baladeva can do everything. He has got three principle potencies—Sri, Bhu and Lila. Sri is Revati, Bhu is Varuni and Lila means His pastimes.

Balaram married to the daughter of Kukudmi. Manu’s son is Sajjati, Sajjati’s son is Aanarta, Aanarta’s son is Revat and Revat’s son is Kukudmi, who is one with Suryadas Sarkhela, the father of Jahnava Devi. Kukudmi approached Brahma, “Where I shall offer my daughter?” Brahma directed that She is the internal potency of Baladeva, so you give your daughter to Baladeva. And Baladeva was married with His potency, Revati. And when married, then Revati was taller than Balaram. It looked awkward. Balaram had the weapon, plow, which He put on the shoulder of Revati and He forced it down, Revati became shorter than Balaram. Baladeva can do everything. Nothing is impossible for Him. He can make His wife shorter with His plow. For that reason we require grace of Baladeva, He also regulates.

Duryodhan had vanity. At that time, what happened? It is explained in Mahabharata also. One of the queens of Krishna, Jambavati, her son’s name is Samba and he was very powerful. Duryodhan's daughter’s name was Lakshamana and at that time there used to be Swayamvara. This mean that a bride will select the groom from so many suitors who come and then will give garland. That was the system. But if someone is powerful he can abduct the bribe. That system was also there. Samba went to the Swayamwara where Lakshamana will select somebody as her husband. He abducted Lakshamana in his chariot. All the Kurus got disturbed, and started fighting with him. The rule of fighting was that only a single person will fight with one person. When they were fighting, all were defeated by Sambha. All were praising Sambha’s valor in the single fight. But then they surrounded him and defeated him in an unlawful fight. And he was taken to custody with Lakshamana. This was reported to Krishna. Krishna said, “So many warriors fought with one person. It is an unlawful fight. I am going with My own army.” He was the King. Baladeva got affection for His disciple Duryodhan, He taught him how to fight with the club. If Krishna goes He might kill Duryodhan. So Balaram said I will go. Baladeva and some brahmins entered Hastinapur. And Dhritarashtra was informed that Baladeva had come. Duryodhan came with happiness to receive his Gurudeva. He performed His Pooja. Baladeva said, “I have come here with the order of Ugrasen. You have illegally fought and arrested Samba and Lakshamana. You give them back to Me. It is the order of Ugrasen.” Duryodhan felt very dejected and insulted that Ugrasen and Yadavas have so much vanity. By our connection with Kunti Devi, they have some power given by us and they are ordering us? Being the shoes of the feet, they want to rise upon the head? Baladeva said, “Oh! You have so much vanity? Is Krishna like a shoe?” (He dicided,) “I shall teach them a lesson. I cannot tolerate this. I shall drown the whole of Hastinapur.” With His plow, He thrust Hastinapur and it drowned. Then Yuddhisthir, Duryodhan and all others also cried, “O Baladeva! Trahi! Trahi! Rescue us! You are the Lord of all Lords, we have committed an offense out of ignorance!” They were shouting. They took absolute shelter to Baladeva and then He forgave them.

You cannot control beasts by sweet words; you can control them by whipping. Baladeva decided, “I am to going to whip them. They are speaking like this for the object of My worship. He is Supreme Lord. They are uttering bad words about Him.” Baladeva also regulates us, governs us. He is our only shelter. He can regulate us from all the evils things and He can give us Shuddh-bhakti and everything on this holy day. He can grace devotees in this world by appearing in their heart. When there are some things of the world, worldly desires, Krishna will not appear there. If I invite you into my house and you have come, outside welcome sign is there but the door is shut, and inside the house all the furniture and irons etc. are packed up then what will you do? You will think there is no place for me to stay and you will leave. When Krishna will come to enter into your heart, but in your heart you have all these persons of the world, all the desires of the world are packed up, He will think that He has got no place to stay and He will go back. You have to do Gundicha-marjana like in Puri-dham, you have to clear all other desires, and then Krishna will come in a sanctified heart. To some devotees, Krishna is gracing today. You do not know whom He will grace.

articles.title: Glories of Lord Baladeva
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: The Supreme Lord, although being one, can perform pastimes or spiritual activities in an infinite variety of forms. Sri Krishna Himself performs His own service in His form of Baladeva. Sri Baladeva—the original Sankarshan (Mula-Sankarshan), has the form of a cowherd boy in Vraja and that of a kshatriya in Dwarka-puri. Sankarshan, of the first catur-vyuha (quadruple expansion), in Dwarka is an amsa- avatar of Mula-Sankarshan (cowherd Baladeva).

blocks.text: Today we should remember, Lord Baladeva, by whose mercy we can get emancipation from this world and can get the service of the lotus feet of Sri Krishna. He is non-different from Krishna Himself. He is Krishna’s potency. It is written in the shloka by Rupa Goswami,

Vishnu has three forms called puruṣa. The first, Karanodakasayi, is the creator of the total material energy (mahat), the second is Garbhodakasayi, who is situated within each universe, and the third is Kshirodakasayi, who lives in the heart of every living being. He who knows these three becomes liberated from the clutches of Māyā.

Mahatattva, the principles of creations manifested from Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu. All living entities are created from the fleeting glance of Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu Who is an amsha-avatara of Sri Baladeva Prabhu. Nothing can be possible with inert material energy. When a conscious principle enters into it then the whole creation manifests. Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu thought, “Ekoham bahu syām: I am one, I shall become many.” Then He glanced upon the inert matter and infinite brahmandas become manifested. And the cause of Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu is Maha-sankarshan.

Sri Baladeva—the original Sankarshan (Mula-Sankarshan), has the form of a cowherd boy in Vraja and that of a kshatriya in Dwarka-puri. Sankarshan of the first catur-vyuha (quadruple expansion) in Dwarka is an aṁśa-āvatāra of Mula-Sankarshan (cowherd Baladeva). Sankarshan, who is in the second catur-vyūha of Narayaṇa in Vaikuntha, is Mahā-Sankarshan—an aṁśa-avatāra of Mula-Sankarshan in the form of a kshatriya belonging to the first catur-vyuha in Dwarka. Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu, the first puruṣa-avatāra, is the aṁśa-avatāra of Maha-Sankarshan and the Supersoul of Māyā-Prakṛti . Karanodakasayi Mahavishnu’s expansion as Garbhodakasayi Vishnu—the second puruṣa-avatāra (Pradyumna), enters into all the universes.

Krishna is also in aiswarya-bhava in Dwarka. Krishna as Dwarkadhisa, the King of Dwarka, came to Kurukshetra with all His opulences on the occasion of solar eclipse. Kurukshetra is near to Vraja-dham. So after being requested by all Vraja-vasis, Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi agreed to come to Kurukshetra and they came there with all residents of Vraja-dham to get the darshan of Krishna.

Narad has complained to Krishna, “You invited the whole world but You did not invite Vraja-vasis. Why so?” Actually Nandanandan Krishna is in Vrindavan only. From outside, He showed to the Vraja-vasis that He is not in Vrindavan to enhance their mood of separation. In Prem (loving relation), union and separation, both are necessary. Therefore, He showed this pastime. In separation of their son, Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi used to cry incessantly. They have deep affection for Krishna, as their son. When Krishna came to Kurukshetra, first they did not want to go there to meet Him, thinking, “He is a great King now. He has so much grandeur, and He had left us long back, maybe, He would have forgotten us by now. Why would He meet us?” But then, all the cowherd boys and gopis were requesting them to go with them to see Krishna. Then they went with them. They went to all gates. They requested to enter. But they were not allowed in. Then they requested to open the gate a little so that they can see Him from a distance. But still gate keeper did not allow them. They all became very disheartened. Then they thought, there is no hope to meet. They became ready to leave their body. They started crying and while crying called out loudly, “Gopal! Gopal!”

The King was sitting in the arena of sacrifice, and all the brahmins were performing the rituals. When He heard the sound of Mother Yashoda calling, 'Gopal! Gopal!' He stood up immediately, removed and threw all His clothes and became a small naked child and ran towards her calling ‘Maa! Maa!’ He came running and embraced His mother Yashoda. Mother Yashoda had tears in her eyes, and out of motherly affection milk started coming out from her breasts for her child.

Now, I would come to the point, here Nanda Maharaj and Mother Yashoda Devi see Krishna and Balaram as their beloved children. Up to the age of five, as small children they were grazing the calves but when they entered in adolescence, now they are allowed to graze cows. I am going to narrate the pastimes of that time period. Those pastimes happened in Tala-vana and Bhandir-vana. As I told before, from Baladeva, Karanodakasayi Vishnu appears and after Him Garbodakasayi Vishnu, who is the antaryami of all the Brahamands, manifests and from Him all the avataras came. From Garbodakasayi Vishnu, Kshirodakasayi Vishnu comes, who is the antaryami of one brahmand, He is situated in heart of every one. Ontologically all are same, Supreme Lord is one, He is not thousands. Chindast api vidayati shirasah krishna svarup... The master of Lakshmi, Narayan, and Krishna are same ontologically, but They differ in Their pastimes. One is in aiswarya-bhava and other one is in madhurya-bhava and Mahaprabhu is in audarya-bhava (in the mood of magnanimity). They differ in Their pastimes, but ontologically all are the same.

To whom do we call Bhagavan? 'Bhaga' means opulences and 'van' means one who possesses them. There are infinite opulences of the Lord, but six are the main. Supreme Lord is infinite and unlimited and there cannot be separate existence of even a small particle. Is there any difference between Rama and Krishna, and Baladeva and Krishna? Ontologically there is no difference. There is difference in pastimes. Lord Rama is Maryada Purusottam (the Lord upholding ethical principles). When the rishis of Dandakaranya expressed their desire in front of Him to serve Him as their husband, then He replied it is not possible in these pastimes. He has taken a wow to keep one wife only. Only Sita Devi has right to serve Him as her husband no one else have that right. When they requested Him again, He told that they would get Him as their husbands in Krishna-lila and will be able to serve Him in the loving guidance of gopis. By the words of Lord Rama, the rishis got Him as their husband in Krishna-lila, but in the form of Rama, He could not fulfil their desire as He is Maryada Purusottam. Is there any difference ontologically? There is no difference. Only pastimes are different.

We sing ‘jay jagdish hare...’, Dasavatar hymn. It is written by Jayadeva Goswami, who is established in top-most madhurya-rasa (in conjugal loving relation with Krishna). He has narrated ten avataras with their respective pastimes and he is offering obeisances to them in his poem. Baladeva is the eighth avatara amongst the ten avataras and twenty-second amongst the twenty five avataras. Supreme Lord is infinite and there are infinite avataras of Him. We think that the names described in the scriptures, those are the only avataras, but it is not like that. There is no limit. Amongst the all avataras, we have direct relation with Dauji, Baladeva. He has affection for all the conditioned souls. At the same time He regulates also. Now, how does He advent? Today is His advent anniversary, so we should hear about Him briefly.

This earth has got a consciousness behind it called ‘Prithvi Devi. If there is no consciousness behind any object then it cannot survive. If the conscious principle present in my body leaves then my body will perish. Similarly as there is no consciousness behind this building, it will be destroyed in due course of time maybe after one thousand or two thousand years. This body is non-eternal. Conscious principle, Lord Baladeva is purna sat-chit-ananda. His appearance is also a pastime. When there were severe oppressions by the sinful persons and demons, Prithvi Devi, the mother earth started crying and went to Brahmaji. She told, “I do not want to live anymore, I suffer so many oppressions upon me.” Then Brahmaji replied, “I have to go to kshira-sagar (ocean of milk) and mediate upon Lord Vishnu and worship Him.” He and all demigods meditated at the shore of kshira-sagar. When he was meditating, a transcendental sound came from the sky. That sound has informed Brahmaji that soon the Lord would appear and asked him to order all the demigods to appear in the Pandava and Yadava dynasty with their potencies. Then Brahmaji followed the order of that transcendental sound and he ordered all the demigods to take birth in these dynasties.

Now, Devaki, who is the daughter of King Ugrasen and sister of Kansa, got married with Vasudeva. Kansa became very much pleased with the marriage of his sister and he desired to drive his sister and her husband's chariot. He was driving the chariot very happily and that time again a transcendental sound came from the sky, “So happily you are driving the chariot of your sister, but you will be killed by her eighth son.” As soon as he heard this sound he became ready to kill her sister and he took hold of her hair. What type of love is it? Vasudeva pleaded to him, “Please do not kill her. She is like your daughter; by killing her you would acquire a great sin.” But he was not ready to listen anything, Then Vasudeva again said, “According to the transcendental sound, Devaki will not kill you but her eighth child will kill you. I give you my word that I will hand over her eighth child to you, whenever he takes birth.” Vasudeva was a righteous person, Kansa had faith upon him so he agreed to him and he left Devaki. When the first child took birth, Vasudeva took him to Kansa, but Kansa told Vasudeva, “I do not have any fear of him. I need only eighth child. You can take him back with you.” Vasudeva thought,
“How can one have faith in the words of a rascal? He sometimes tells the truth and sometimes falsehoods. Just as with the clouds of Shravan-sometimes there is sunshine and sometimes rain.”

Vasudeva took him back. Narad visits various places. He is liked by everyone, by demons as well as by demigods. He reveals secrets of others to everyone. One day Narad met Kansa. Kansa shared everything with him. Narad told him, “How will you count the eighth child, from the beginning or from the end? It is possible to count from both the sides.” Thus Narad sowed a seed of doubt in his heart. Narad further told to him, “I heard all the demigods have taken birth in Yadava and Pandava dynasties and Supreme Lord is going to appear to kill you.” By saying this Narad left that place. Immediately, Kansa ordered to bring Devaki's first child to him. He killed the child in front of everyone. Would any mother be happy by the murder of his son? Like that he killed the first six sons. Apparently, it looks like he killed the six sons of Devaki and Vasudeva but actually he killed his own sons.

Perhaps many people do not know but there is one past story behind it. There was a demon under the shelter of Hiranyakasipu, he had six sons. He sent his six sons for meditation without taking permission from Hiranyakasipu. But there was a rule that everyone must take permission from him before doing anything. So Hiranyakasipu became enraged and cursed the demon that he would kill his own sons in his next life. So now he took his birth as Kansa and those six children were his own sons in his past life. Everything is done by Supreme Lord's potencies. Mahamaya and Yogamaya are the two potencies of the Lord. If Kansa would have known that those were his own sons from his past life then would he have killed them? But by the influence of Yogamaya, he could not know that. Actually he was killing his own sons. This material world is like this only. Have you heard it before? All the material relations of this world are very dangerous. We do not have intelligence so we do not believe that they are not good.

Now, the Supreme Lord ordered Yogamaya to transfer the seventh womb of Devaki to Rohini in Gokul. Therefore, Balaram is known as Rohini-Nandan. In this material world Mahamaya makes us all forget everything, like that in transcendental world, Yogamaya, to fulfill the pastimes, makes everyone forget everything. Nobody can know. By the influence of Yogamaya, everyone thought that Devaki had a miscarriage, but it was not a miscarriage, it was a transfer of womb of Devaki to the womb of Rohini.

articles.title: On the Occasion of Baladeva Purnima
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: In this harikatha, Srila Gurudeva narrates the glories of Lord Baladeva, who is non-different from Krishna. He explains the ontological aspect of Baladeva along with various pastimes He performed for the welfare of conditioned souls. He explains the deep significance of all His pastimes and imparts us the valuable teachings.

blocks.text: At this time we usually stay in Vrindavan. Those who have gone to Vrindavan will arrive here before Janmashtami. I had been told to stay in Vrindavan where many devotees will come but due to the condition of my health I couldn’t go there as the doctor has advised me not to move too much. Everything happens by divine will. So, it is Krishna’s desire that I stay in Kolkata Math during the Jhulan festival and the day of appearance of Sri Baladeva after a long time. Where devotees stay together is also Dhama (abode of the Lord). In fact actual Dhama is where Vaishnavas stay together. You go for pilgrimage there also you need the association of devotees. Otherwise you cannot understand the significance of the various pilgrimage sites and will see them as ordinary villages and towns.

This place (Kolkata Math) is also Vrindavan Dham since here resides the worshipable object of our most revered Gurudeva, Sri Sri Guru Gauranga Radha Nayananathjiu. Sri ChaitanyaGaudiya Math is not a place within Kolkata, or India or within the world. It is the transcendental abode of the Lord which has descended in this place. Since the Lord Sri Hari is nirguna (transcendental), His Dhama (abode) is also nirguna. Our Paramgurudeva, who stayed at the BaghbazarGaudiya Math in Kolkata (then called Kalikata) used to say,“I donot reside in the abode of Kali, called Kalikata.” All the listeners were astonished to hear this since the Math is located at Kolkata. His view was, since his worshipable object Sri Sri Guru Gauranga Radha Govindajiu is present there, the Math is non-different from Vrindavan Dhama and Navadwip Dhama. So, Sri Chaitanya Gaudiya Math is not a place of this world. Here the worshipable object is Krishna and wherever there is the target to please the senses of Krishna, that place is Vrindavan. Wherever there is the target to please my own senses, that place is the material place. Krishna has said in the Gita, “I am the only enjoyer”. All others are to be enjoyed by Him and serve Him as man-servants (sevaks) or maid-servants (sevikas). That place is Vrindavan or Vaikuntha Dhama.

In this material world everybody has forgotten the Lord and is trying to become small Krishna and take the mood of an enjoyer like Him. They try to enjoy each other and this result in troubles and disturbances. Taking the mood of an enjoyer they fall into the whirlpool of birth, death and threefold afflictions. Actually I am an eternal servant of the Lord but leaving aside my real nature I am trying to enjoy worldly pleasures. But I can only enjoy material objects and not the Supreme Lord who is transcendental and beyond all material qualities. So one can only enjoy inferior things which are perishable, devoid of any knowledge and devoid of any bliss. In this human birth, the Lord has given us intelligence so that we can leave inferior objects (devoid of eternity, knowledge and bliss) and accept the superior object, the Lord. Other living entities doesn’t have this discriminating power. One cannot suddenly obtain this human birth. After passing through the births of eighty lacs species one rarely obtains this human birth. The Lord becomes satisfied after creating human beings because they can worship Him. Only human beings can enquire about eternity etc. and have discriminating sense between good and bad, eternal and non-eternal etc. Even taking birth as a demigod is not congenial for performing worship since in that birth there is too much sense enjoyment. When there is much sense-enjoyment one forgets the Lord. What to speak of inferior beings who don’t have the sense of discriminating power between good and bad. How can they perform bhajan? So, only human birth is congenial for performing worship of the Supreme Lord.

The four traits, namely eating, sleeping, defending and mating, are performed by both beasts, birds and human beings. So what is the difference? Beasts and birds cannot perform worship of the Supreme Lord which human beings can. This is the only difference. So, this place which is established by Gurudeva is also Dhama (abode of the Lord). Even if I go to Dhama, I may stay at home. I may think of my homely affairs, assets etc. even while staying inDhama. Wherever my mind is, I am actually staying there. So, I am staying by my body in Dhama, but mentally I am staying at home. Even while staying here, if I am thinking of Vrindavana, then I am actually staying there. Similarly the reverse is also true. Wherever my mind is, I am staying there actually. So, the place which is giving me remembrances of the Lord is also Dhama.

Today is the holy appearance day of Baladeva Prabhu who is the eighth one among the ten avataras of the Supreme Lord. After Him, comes two other avataras, namely Buddha and Kalki. Sri Baladeva Prabhu is non-different from Krishna. Parameshwar or the Supreme Lord can never be more than one. Obviously, He can have many potencies but He, Himself cannot be more than one. But as per His different pastimes, He can appear in many forms (lila-avataras). As per one scripture in South India, Lakshmi-pati (the husband of the Goddess of fortune) and Radha-pati (The husband of SrimatiRadhika) are one and the same person, but as per pastimes and mellows there is difference between them. Desiring to take part in the Rasa-lila pastimes of Radha Krishna, Sri or Lakshmi devi performed penances in Bilwavana(one of the forests among the twelve forests of Vrindavana) but still she couldn’t enter those pastimes. The only reason behind this was she tried to perform penances in the mood of opulence. But wherever there is mood of opulence or aishwarya, Narayana becomes prominent, not Krishna. On the other hand, the sages of Dandak-aranya got attracted to the form of Lord Ramachandra and desired to have Him as their husband. But Lord Rama denied by telling them that in this avatara He is playing the pastime of Maryada Purushottam (the Lord upholding ethical principles) and can only have one wife (Sita Devi). But He blessed them by telling that He will fulfil their desire when He will appear as Krishna in Vrindavan and they will also appear as gopis (milk-maids). So by the grace of Lord Ramachandra all these sages appeared as milk-maids during the avatara of Krishna and served Him.

The Lord’s pastimes as Krishna are the topmost where all sorts of divine mellows are present. So as per tattva, there are no differences in the avataras of the Lord, the only difference lies in the mellows. An example can be cited of a king who, despite being the same person, behaves differently in his court and in his palace with his associates. In his court he behaves officially and formally but in his palace inner-chambers he behaves informally with his family members and relatives with love and affection. Likewise there are not many Ishwars (Lords). Krishna is the Supreme Person and Baladeva is non-different from Him. Krishna is serving Himself in His form as Baladeva. So, despite being Vastu Tattva (the enjoyer Lord) Baladeva is also Guru Tattva. But, unlike our Gurudeva, He is not Shakti Tattva. So the Lord Himself has appeared as Guru and is both serving Himself and bestowing service to others. Without Lord Baladeva’s grace one cannot get Krishna since without the grace of Guru one can never get the Lord. The Lord has taken the form of servitor Himself and teaching others how to serve Him. In the Mundaka Upanishad it is stated that the meaning of the term ‘Bala’ is strength. Here strength doesn’t mean physical strength it means grace. Without the grace of Baladeva one cannot obtain either Him or Krishna whom Baladeva serves in five forms. In Vaikuntha, Baladeva exists as Maha-Shankarsan. In the Karana ocean, He exists as Karanadakshayi Mahavishnu. Next, innumerable universes were created and there He created a place (Garbha) for Himself and came to be known as Garbhadakshayi Vishnu. After that He entered into each and every universe and resided in the milk ocean as Kshirodakshayi Vishnu who is also the Super-soul in the hearts of all the living entities whom the yogis meditate upon.
